items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I talked to Leslie Sheffield out in Oklahoma City and Leslie told me that when he was in high school he booked the band... [INTERVIEWEE] He is. It's got on here Eugene Crooke, R. Leslie Sheffield.

ctx.x: (Inaudible). Jimmy was so good that we kept him.

And then later on--I talked to Leslie Sheffield out in Oklahoma City and Leslie told me that when he was in high school he booked the band to play some dances, some high school dances or something out there. This must have been the time that he came in--he came in the band as a tuba player and also played piano, too. This is when Trent was in the band because he was supposed to be on this last record.
He is. It's got on here Eugene Crooke, R. Leslie Sheffield.
